text: Sunken stone halls in the March Steppe and Highlands. Only a ladder shaft shows at the surface.
Ancestor Halls are buried: look for a ladder shaft dropping into the ground. Below are three rooms under Loom-wood beams, lit by old lanterns.
**Hollow Sentinels** keep the side rooms, three of them in every hall. They hit hard and weaken your grip, so light the rooms as you go and keep a charged staff handy for distance.
pages.title: Finding one

text: Four **Lore Tablets** hang on the walls. Right-click each one to read it; the first read is recorded in this Codex, which counts how many of the **12** fragments you have found. Drum Circles and the Crystal Spire hold the rest.

Two chests stand at the far end. Each always holds **2 to 4 Loom Thread**, plus a handful of echoes, Echo Shards, Spirit Shards, Spiritweave, March Crystal or a Blank Seal, and sometimes an elemental seal.
Loom Thread is the reason most people come. It is the first step toward [the sixth voice](sixth_voice).
pages.title: What the hall keeps

text: Eight March Stone around an Echo Shard carve **2 Lore Tablets**. Hang them on a wall at home to mark your own hall; they sit flat against the block behind them and fall if it is removed.
